rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is easily hurt, or for a topic or negotiation that requires tact.

example.english: This topic is sensitive, so it needs to be handled carefully during the meeting.
example.traditional: 呢個議題好敏感，開會嗰陣要小心處理。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 hou2 man5 gam2 hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this for information or documents that are meant to be kept secret.

example.english: This document is sensitive and must not be taken out for others to see.
example.traditional: 呢份文件係機密，唔可以攞出去畀人睇。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 man4 gin6 hai6 gei1 mat6 m4 ho2 ji5 lo2 ceot1 heoi3 bei2 jan4 tai2

rows.note: Use this when sensitive means considerate of other people's feelings rather than easily offended.

example.english: They are very sensitive to other people's feelings and offer to carry my bag when they see I am tired.
example.traditional: 佢好體貼，見我攰就主動幫我拎袋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 tai2 tip3 gin3 ngo5 gui6 zau6 zyu2 dung6 bong1 ngo5 ling1 doi2
